gen-gf-tektur-gf-krona-one: Krona One has the stature of cast iron capitals, wide and loosely spaced, even in lowercase. Krona One against Tektur's open-ended curves feels like heavy machinery beside a drawing of it, a plain sans with real weight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-magra: Tektur draws its strokes like bent pipe cleaner, one line weight throughout. Magra follows with a big-bodied plain sans that gives those thin, wiry shapes something solid to stand on.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display glows like neon tubing, with generous space around every letter. Tektur's outsized lowercase takes the heading, and the monospace body lights up quietly beneath it, so the page feels like a control panel at night.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-martian-mono: Tektur opens every curve generously and leans on outsized lowercase for its personality. And Martian Mono, a monospace with fixed-width, far-apart letters, gives the pair its strongest quality: a structured, code-like order.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-matemasie: Matemasie has small entry points into its round letters and broad gaps between glyphs, so each word breathes. Tektur's wide-open curves above it make a loose, friendly sort of structure.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-menbere: Clean and quiet, Menbere stacks its lowercase tall like rolled cord. Menbere against Tektur's gentle monotone line gives the pair its strongest quality: a sans body that never fights the expressive heading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mitr: Mitr reads compact and contemporary, with almost no gap between x-height and cap height. Mitr then sets a sturdy sans beneath Tektur's compass-pencil consistency, and that tight, even look is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-momo-trust-display: Wide-spaced and crisp. Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes carry the heading, while Momo Trust Display, a sans with a generous x-height and drifting letters, spreads out softly underneath.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta: Tall, tidy lowercase under a stout heading. Mukta carries a long read in a plain sans whose small letters stand upright, a steady counterpart to Tektur's thick crossbars.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta-mahee: Tektur is built from open curves and strokes without modulation, giving the heading a wiry, drawn feel at any size. Mukta Mahee is the chunky one.
